title: P6 Activity Release 26 tertiary baseline typed semantic evidence tranche
reference_version: Oracle Primavera P6 EPPM REST API Release 26
certification_rule: This artifact certifies only the documented read-side API type, unit, and semantic description. Writable/default/nullability/import-export and full stored-vs-computed certification remain open; no Registry identity is changed by this tranche.

fields.description: Duration for the activity in the tertiary baseline; duration is total working time from activity current start to current finish, with working time computed using the activity calendar.
Current finish date of the activity in the user's tertiary baseline; planned finish while not started, remaining finish while in progress, and actual finish once completed.

Planned duration for the activity in the tertiary baseline; total working time from current start to current finish, using the activity calendar. Named Baseline 3 Budgeted Duration in Primavera Engineering & Construction and Maintenance & Turnaround solutions.
Planned costs for all project expenses associated with the activity; named Baseline 3 Budgeted Expense Cost in Primavera Engineering & Construction and Maintenance & Turnaround solutions.

Oracle Release 26 response text describes this tertiary-baseline field as planned costs for all project expenses associated with the activity and names it Baseline Budgeted Expense Cost in Primavera Engineering & Construction and Maintenance & Turnaround solutions; the wording is preserved as published pending semantic reconciliation.
Planned units for all labor resources assigned to the activity; named Baseline 3 Budgeted Labor Units in Primavera Engineering & Construction and Maintenance & Turnaround solutions.
Planned Material Cost for the activity in the user's tertiary baseline.
Planned costs for all nonlabor resources assigned to the activity; if no resources are assigned, computed from planned nonlabor units and project default price/time.
Planned units for all nonlabor resources assigned to the activity; named Baseline 3 Budgeted Non Labor Units in Primavera Engineering & Construction and Maintenance & Turnaround solutions.

Planned total cost for the activity in the tertiary baseline including labor, nonlabor, and project expenses; planned total cost = planned labor cost + planned nonlabor cost + planned expense cost. Named Baseline 3 Budgeted Total Cost in Primavera Engineering & Construction and Maintenance & Turnaround solutions.
Current start date of the activity in the user's tertiary baseline; planned start until the activity is started, then actual start.
